meta.label: refresh.py
meta.value:
"""Rebuild the Dota Pro Savant data files from the OpenDota API.

Usage: python -I refresh.py <out_dir>

Window: every premium/professional-tier pro match from the start of The International 2025 to now.
The dashboard aggregates these per-match rows itself for whatever date range the viewer picks.

Writes into out_dir:
  pm.csv       one row per listed pro per match (position already assigned)
  players.csv  pro id, name, team, country
  herolist.csv hero id -> name
  leagues.csv  league id -> name, tier
  events.csv   The International start/end dates inside the window (date-filter presets)
  patches.csv  game patches inside the window with first/last game date (date-filter presets)
  scope.json   {rows, meta}: window dates, match count, hero-position counts, plus this script as meta
  tournaments.csv  recent events with champion, final and xWin leader
  teams.csv    every counted team: name, current Elo, Tier 1 now
  heroart.csv  hero art sheet positions (sheets: hero-sprite.jpg, hero-pixel.png; see sprites.py)
  refreshlog.csv  one line per refresh (also kept in history/ beside this script with a copy of model.csv)

Junk leagues and unregistered-team games are dropped and opponents are tiered by tiers.py.
Prints HERO_ART_CHANGED when the hero list changed and the two sheets must be re-uploaded.
"""
import collections, csv, datetime, json, os, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.parse

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import xwin  # noqa: E402  (the xWin model lives beside this script)
import tiers  # noqa: E402  (junk filter, Tier 1 teams, team Elo)
import sprites  # noqa: E402  (hero art sheets)
import extras  # noqa: E402  (item timings, vision, runes, objectives, time dead, lane result, deciders)

API = "https://api.opendota.com/api"
TI_2025_LEAGUE = 18324          # The International 2025; the window starts at its first match
CHUNK = 300
HERO_SHARE = 0.6                # a hero is "single-position" if 60%+ of its pro games are in one position
HERO_MIN_GAMES = 20             # ...and it has at least this many pro games in the window
TIERS = ("premium", "professional")


def get(url, tries=5):
    last = None
    for i in range(tries):
        out = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", "--max-time", "180", url], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8").stdout
        try:
            d = json.loads(out)
            if isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("err"):
                raise RuntimeError(d["err"])
            return d
        except Exception as e:  # retry on timeouts / bad JSON
            last = e
            time.sleep(3 * (i + 1))
    raise RuntimeError(f"failed after {tries} tries: {url[:120]} ({last})")


def sql(q):
    return get(f"{API}/explorer?sql=" + urllib.parse.quote(q))["rows"]


def day(t):
    return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t, datetime.UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def main(out_dir, cached=False):
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    if cached:  # reuse the last pull (for testing model changes without re-downloading)
        raw = json.load(open(os.path.join(out_dir, "raw_pm.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
        if raw["matches"] and "g20" not in raw["matches"][0]:  # older pulls: add the gold lead at 20:00 once
            ids = sorted(m["match_id"] for m in raw["matches"])
            g = {}
            for i in range(0, len(ids), 1000):
                for row in sql("SELECT match_id, radiant_gold_adv[21] AS g20 FROM matches WHERE match_id IN (" + ",".join(map(str, ids[i:i + 1000])) + ")"):
                    g[row["match_id"]] = row["g20"]
            for m in raw["matches"]:
                m["g20"] = g.get(m["match_id"])
            with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "raw_pm.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(raw, f)
        if "extras" not in raw:  # older pulls: add the parsed-replay extras once
            raw["extras"] = extras.fetch({m["match_id"] for m in raw["matches"]}, extras.big_items(get(f"{API}/constants/items")))
            with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "raw_pm.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(raw, f)
        return build(out_dir, raw["matches"], raw["pm"])
    start = sql(f"SELECT min(start_time) AS t FROM matches WHERE leagueid = {TI_2025_LEAGUE}")[0]["t"]
    start = start - start % 86400  # midnight UTC of TI 2025 day one
    matches = sql("SELECT match_id, radiant_win, duration, start_time, leagueid, radiant_team_id, dire_team_id, series_id, series_type, "
                  "radiant_gold_adv[21] AS g20 "
                  f"FROM matches WHERE start_time >= {start}")
    leagues = {l["leagueid"]: l for l in get(f"{API}/leagues")}
    M = {m["match_id"]: m for m in matches if leagues.get(m["leagueid"], {}).get("tier") in TIERS}
    ids = list(M)
    print(f"{len(M)} tier-1/2 matches since {day(start)}", flush=True)
    pm = []
    for i in range(0, len(ids), CHUNK):
        chunk = ",".join(map(str, ids[i:i + CHUNK]))
        pm += sql("SELECT match_id, account_id, hero_id, player_slot, kills, deaths, assists, gold_per_min, xp_per_min, "
                  "last_hits, denies, hero_damage, tower_damage, hero_healing, obs_placed, sen_placed, stuns, "
                  "teamfight_participation, camps_stacked, gold_t[11] AS g10, xp_t[11] AS x10, lh_t[11] AS l10, dn_t[11] AS d10, "
                  "lane_role, is_roaming "
                  f"FROM player_matches WHERE match_id IN ({chunk})")
        print(f"player rows: {len(pm)}", flush=True)
    P = get(f"{API}/proPlayers")
    H = get(f"{API}/constants/heroes")
    PATCHES = get(f"{API}/constants/patch")
    EXTRAS = extras.fetch(set(M), extras.big_items(get(f"{API}/constants/items")))
    team_ids = sorted({t for m in M.values() for t in (m.get("radiant_team_id"), m.get("dire_team_id")) if t})
    teams = []
    for i in range(0, len(team_ids), 500):
        teams += sql("SELECT team_id, name, tag FROM teams WHERE team_id IN (" + ",".join(map(str, team_ids[i:i + 500])) + ")")
    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "raw_pm.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"matches": list(M.values()), "pm": pm, "pros": P, "heroes": H, "leagues": list(leagues.values()),
                   "teams": teams, "patches": PATCHES, "extras": EXTRAS}, f)
    return build(out_dir, list(M.values()), pm)


def write_tournaments(out_dir, M, pm, leagues, teams, P):
    """One row per league in the window: dates, champion/runner-up from the final series, and the event's xWin leader.

    The final series is the series that contains the league's last match. A league whose last match is within
    2 days of the newest match in the data is marked "In progress" and its latest series is shown instead.
    """
    tname = lambda t: (teams.get(t) or {}).get("name") or ("Team " + str(t) if t else "Unknown team")
    newest = max(m["start_time"] for m in M.values())
    by_league = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for m in M.values():
        by_league[m["leagueid"]].append(m)
    rows_by_match = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in pm:
        rows_by_match[r["match_id"]].append(r)
    out = []
    for lid, ms in by_league.items():
        if len(ms) < 6:
            continue
        ms.sort(key=lambda m: m["start_time"])
        last = ms[-1]
        # Skip open ladders, in-house leagues and streamer shows: real events last at most ~4 months,
        # have 4+ teams, and their last match is between two known teams.
        n_teams = len({t for m in ms for t in (m.get("radiant_team_id"), m.get("dire_team_id")) if t})
        name = (leagues[lid]["name"] or "")
        if (last["start_time"] - ms[0]["start_time"] > 120 * 86400 or n_teams < 4 or "streamer" in name.lower()
                or not teams.get(last.get("radiant_team_id")) or not teams.get(last.get("dire_team_id"))):
            continue
        series =[m for m in ms if last.get("series_id") and m.get("series_id") == last["series_id"]] or [last]
        sides = [last.get("radiant_team_id"), last.get("dire_team_id")]
        wins = {t: 0 for t in sides}
        for m in series:
            w = m.get("radiant_team_id") if m["radiant_win"] else m.get("dire_team_id")
            if w in wins:
                wins[w] += 1
        (a, wa), (b, wb) = sorted(wins.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if len(wins) == 2 else [(sides[0], 0), (sides[0], 0)]
        in_progress = newest - last["start_time"] < 2 * 86400
        acc = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for m in ms:
            for r in rows_by_match[m["match_id"]]:
                if r["account_id"] in P and r.get("xwin") is not None:
                    acc[r["account_id"]].append(r)
        mvp = None
        for pid, rs in acc.items():
            if len(rs) >= 5:
                x = sum(r["xwin"] for r in rs) / len(rs)
                if mvp is None or x > mvp[1]:
                    pos = collections.Counter(r["pos"] for r in rs).most_common(1)[0][0]
                    mvp = (pid, x, len(rs), pos)
        out.append(dict(
            league=lid, name=(leagues[lid]["name"] or "").strip(), tier=leagues[lid]["tier"], tier1=int(tiers.is_tier1_event(leagues[lid]["name"])), start=day(ms[0]["start_time"]), end=day(last["start_time"]),
            matches=len(ms), teams=len({t for m in ms for t in (m.get("radiant_team_id"), m.get("dire_team_id")) if t}),
            status="In progress" if in_progress else "Finished",
            champion="" if in_progress else tname(a), runner_up="" if in_progress else tname(b),
            series_a=tname(a), series_b=tname(b), series_score=f"{wa}-{wb}",
            mvp_id=mvp[0] if mvp else "", mvp_name=(P[mvp[0]].get("name") or "").strip() if mvp else "",
            mvp_xwin=round(mvp[1] * 100, 1) if mvp else "", mvp_games=mvp[2] if mvp else "", mvp_pos=mvp[3] if mvp else ""))
    out.sort(key=lambda r: (r["end"], r["matches"]), reverse=True)
    cols = ["league", "name", "tier", "tier1", "start", "end", "matches", "teams", "status", "champion", "runner_up", "series_a", "series_b",
            "series_score", "mvp_id", "mvp_name", "mvp_xwin", "mvp_games", "mvp_pos"]
    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "tournaments.csv"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=cols)
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(out)


def build(out_dir, matches, pm):
    raw = json.load(open(os.path.join(out_dir, "raw_pm.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    leagues = {l["leagueid"]: l for l in raw["leagues"]}
    M = {m["match_id"]: m for m in matches}
    P = {p["account_id"]: p for p in raw["pros"]}
    H = {h["id"]: h["localized_name"] for h in raw["heroes"].values()}
    TEAMS = {t["team_id"]: t for t in raw.get("teams", [])}

    # ---- Which games count (see tiers.py) ----
    n_all = len(M)
    M, dropped = tiers.filter_matches(M, leagues, TEAMS)
    pm = [r for r in pm if r["match_id"] in M]
    elo_now, t1_now = tiers.team_tiers_and_elo(M, leagues)
    # Game patch: the newest OpenDota patch released before the match started.
    patches = sorted(((datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(x["date"].replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp(), x["name"])
                      for x in (raw.get("patches") or get(f"{API}/constants/patch"))))
    for m in M.values():
        m["patch"] = max((p for p in patches if p[0] <= m["start_time"]), default=patches[0])[1]
    for r in pm:
        m = M[r["match_id"]]
        rad = r["player_slot"] < 128
        r["team"], r["opp"] = (m["radiant_team_id"], m["dire_team_id"]) if rad else (m["dire_team_id"], m["radiant_team_id"])
        r["opp_elo"] = m["d_elo"] if rad else m["r_elo"]
        r["opp_tier"] = m["d_tier"] if rad else m["r_tier"]
        r["patch"] = m["patch"]
        # Gold lead at 20:00 from this player's side (None for games shorter than 20 minutes).
        r["lead20"] = None if m.get("g20") is None else (m["g20"] if rad else -m["g20"])
    print(f"kept {len(M)} of {n_all} matches; dropped leagues: " + "; ".join(
        f"{(leagues[l]['name'] or '').strip()} ({why})" for l, why in dropped.items()), flush=True)

    # ---- Position: hero first, gold second ----
    # A: GPM rank within the side for that match (1 = richest).
    side = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in pm:
        side[(r["match_id"], r["player_slot"] < 128)].append(r)
    for g in side.values():
        for i, r in enumerate(sorted(g, key=lambda r: -(r["gold_per_min"] or 0))):
            r["gold_pos"] = i + 1
    # B: a hero is single-position when pros played it in one position in HERO_SHARE+ of its games.
    hero_pos_counts = collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
    for r in pm:
        hero_pos_counts[r["hero_id"]][r["gold_pos"]] += 1
    hero_pos = {}
    for h, c in hero_pos_counts.items():
        n = sum(c.values())
        p, k = c.most_common(1)[0]
        if n >= HERO_MIN_GAMES and k / n >= HERO_SHARE:
            hero_pos[h] = p
    # C: lanes first. OpenDota's lane_role (1 safe, 2 mid, 3 off, 4 jungle) says where each player laned.
    #    A lone mid laner is Pos 2. A safe lane with exactly two players: richer = Pos 1, other = Pos 5.
    #    An off lane with exactly two players: richer = Pos 3, other = Pos 4. (by_hero = 2 marks these.)
    # D: anyone left (unparsed games, trilanes, jungle, odd lanes): single-position heroes claim an open slot
    #    (richer player wins a clash, by_hero = 1); the rest fill the open slots by gold (by_hero = 0).
    gpm = lambda r: r["gold_per_min"] or 0
    for g in side.values():
        taken = set()
        lanes = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for r in g:
            if r.get("lane_role") in (1, 2, 3):
                lanes[r["lane_role"]].append(r)
        if len(lanes[2]) == 1:
            lanes[2][0]["pos"], lanes[2][0]["by_hero"] = 2, 2
            taken.add(2)
        for lane, (core, sup) in ((1, (1, 5)), (3, (3, 4))):
            if len(lanes[lane]) == 2:
                a, b = sorted(lanes[lane], key=lambda r: -gpm(r))
                a["pos"], a["by_hero"], b["pos"], b["by_hero"] = core, 2, sup, 2
                taken.update((core, sup))
        for r in sorted((r for r in g if "pos" not in r), key=lambda r: -gpm(r)):
            p = hero_pos.get(r["hero_id"])
            if p and p not in taken:
                taken.add(p)
                r["pos"], r["by_hero"] = p, 1
        open_pos = [p for p in range(1, 6) if p not in taken]
        rest = sorted((r for r in g if "pos" not in r), key=lambda r: -(r["gold_per_min"] or 0))
        for p, r in zip(open_pos, rest):
            r["pos"], r["by_hero"] = p, 0

    # ---- D: xWin model (see xwin.py) ----
    extras.derive(pm, M, raw.get("extras", []))
    xwin.build_features(pm, M)
    feat_rows = [r for r in pm if r.get("feat")]
    for r in feat_rows:
        r["date"] = day(M[r["match_id"]]["start_time"])
    xwin.adjust_features(feat_rows)
    # Validation 1: train on everything before the last 120 days, test on the last 120 days.
    cut = day(max(m["start_time"] for m in M.values()) - 120 * 86400)
    tr = [r for r in feat_rows if r["date"] < cut]
    te = [r for r in feat_rows if r["date"] >= cut]
    from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
    score = lambda rows: round(float(roc_auc_score([r["win"] for r in rows], [r["xwin"] for r in rows])), 3)
    auc, auc_patch = {}, {}
    for name, feats in [("xwin", xwin.FEATURES), ("lane", xwin.EARLY)]:
        xwin.predict(xwin.fit_all(tr, feats), te, feats)
        auc[name] = score(te)
        # Same test, but each patch with enough games gets its own model.
        xwin.predict_by_patch(xwin.fit_by_patch(tr, feats), te, feats)
        auc_patch[name] = score(te)
    # Per-patch models are kept only if they beat the all-patch model on unseen games.
    per_patch = auc_patch["xwin"] > auc["xwin"]
    print(f"all-patch AUC {auc['xwin']} vs per-patch AUC {auc_patch['xwin']}: using {'per-patch' if per_patch else 'all-patch'} models", flush=True)
    auc_all = auc["xwin"]
    if per_patch:
        auc = auc_patch
    fit = (lambda rows, f: xwin.fit_by_patch(rows, f)) if per_patch else (lambda rows, f: xwin.fit_all(rows, f))
    pred = xwin.predict_by_patch if per_patch else xwin.predict
    # Final models: fit on all rows.
    lane_models = fit(feat_rows, xwin.EARLY)
    pred(lane_models, feat_rows, xwin.EARLY)
    for r in feat_rows:
        r["xlane"] = r.pop("xwin")
    models = fit(feat_rows, xwin.FEATURES)
    pred(models, feat_rows, xwin.FEATURES)
    if per_patch:
        models = models["global"]  # the weights table shows the all-patch fit
    # Validation 2: repeatability. For pros with 40+ games in each half of their matches (odd vs even),
    # how well does half A predict half B, for xWin and for actual win %?
    by = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in feat_rows:
        if r["account_id"] in P:
            by[r["account_id"]].append(r)
    pairs = []
    for rs in by.values():
        rs.sort(key=lambda r: (r["date"], r["match_id"]))
        a, b = rs[0::2], rs[1::2]
        if len(a) >= 40 and len(b) >= 40:
            mean = lambda h, k: sum(r[k] for r in h) / len(h)
            pairs.append([mean(a, "xwin"), mean(b, "xwin"), mean(a, "win"), mean(b, "win")])
    pairs = np.array(pairs)
    rep_x = round(float(np.corrcoef(pairs[:, 0], pairs[:, 1])[0, 1]), 2)
    rep_w = round(float(np.corrcoef(pairs[:, 2], pairs[:, 3])[0, 1]), 2)
    # Shrinkage for small samples: how many games of the position average a player's xWin is worth.
    # k = per-game spread / true spread between players (method of moments, pros with 30+ games at the position).
    # The dashboard shows (games * xWin + k * position average) / (games + k).
    import statistics as st
    shrink = {}
    for key in ("xwin", "xlane"):
        ks = []
        for pos in range(1, 6):
            per = collections.defaultdict(list)
            for r in feat_rows:
                if r["pos"] == pos and r["account_id"] in P and r.get(key) is not None:
                    per[r["account_id"]].append(r[key])
            g = [v for v in per.values() if len(v) >= 30]
            within = st.mean(st.variance(v) for v in g)
            true = st.variance([st.mean(v) for v in g]) - st.mean(within / len(v) for v in g)
            ks.append(str(max(5, min(80, round(within / true)))) if true > 0 else "30")
        shrink[key] = ",".join(ks)
    print(f"shrinkage games by position: xWin {shrink['xwin']}, lane {shrink['xlane']}", flush=True)
    W = xwin.weights(models)
    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "model.csv"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["pos", "feature", "label", "group", "weight"])
        for pos in range(1, 6):
            for ft in xwin.FEATURES:
                w.writerow([pos, ft, xwin.LABELS[ft], "10-minute" if ft in xwin.EARLY else "Whole game", round(W[pos][ft], 2)])
    print(f"xWin test AUC {auc['xwin']}, lane AUC {auc['lane']}, repeatability xWin {rep_x} vs win% {rep_w} (n={len(pairs)})", flush=True)

    # ---- E: recent tournament results ----
    write_tournaments(out_dir, M, pm, leagues, TEAMS, P)

    # ---- F: teams (name, current Elo, Tier 1 now) and hero art ----
    games = collections.Counter(t for m in M.values() for t in (m["radiant_team_id"], m["dire_team_id"]))
    last = {}
    for m in M.values():
        for t in (m["radiant_team_id"], m["dire_team_id"]):
            last[t] = max(last.get(t, 0), m["start_time"])
    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "teams.csv"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["team", "name", "tag", "elo", "tier1", "games", "last"])
        for t in sorted(games, key=lambda t: -elo_now.get(t, 1500)):
            w.writerow([t, (TEAMS[t].get("name") or "").strip(), (TEAMS[t].get("tag") or "").strip(), round(elo_now.get(t, 1500)),
                        int(t1_now.get(t, False)), games[t], day(last[t])])
    art_changed = sprites.build(out_dir, raw["heroes"])

    # ---- Write files ----
    def num(v, nd=None):
        if v is None:
            return ""
        return round(v, nd) if nd is not None else v

    cols = ["id", "match_id", "date", "league", "hero", "pos", "by_hero", "win", "k", "d", "a", "gpm", "xpm",
            "lh", "den", "dmg", "td", "heal", "stun", "tf", "wards", "stack", "sec", "xwin", "xlane",
            "team", "opp", "opp_tier", "opp_elo", "patch",
            "lane_res", "big_t", "big_vs", "bkb_t", "dead_pct", "dew", "obs_n", "obs_kill", "pwr", "wis", "bnty", "tow", "rosh", "fb", "decider", "lead20"]
    pro_ids = set()
    rows = 0
    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "pm.csv"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(cols)
        for r in sorted(pm, key=lambda r: (M[r["match_id"]]["start_time"], r["match_id"], r["player_slot"])):
            if r["account_id"] not in P or "pos" not in r:
                continue
            m = M[r["match_id"]]
            wards = None if r["obs_placed"] is None and r["sen_placed"] is None else (r["obs_placed"] or 0) + (r["sen_placed"] or 0)
            tf = None if r["teamfight_participation"] is None else r["teamfight_participation"] * 100
            w.writerow([r["account_id"], r["match_id"], day(m["start_time"]), m["leagueid"], r["hero_id"], r["pos"], r["by_hero"],
                        int((r["player_slot"] < 128) == m["radiant_win"]), r["kills"], r["deaths"], r["assists"],
                        r["gold_per_min"], r["xp_per_min"], r["last_hits"], r["denies"], r["hero_damage"], r["tower_damage"],
                        r["hero_healing"], num(r["stuns"], 1), num(tf, 1), num(wards), num(r["camps_stacked"]), m["duration"],
                        num(r.get("xwin"), 3), num(r.get("xlane"), 3), r["team"], r["opp"], r["opp_tier"], r["opp_elo"], r["patch"],
                        num(r.get("lane_res")), num(r["x_big_t"] / 60 if r.get("x_big_t") and r["x_big_t"] > 0 else None, 1),
                        num(r.get("big_vs"), 1), num(r["x_bkb_t"] / 60 if r.get("x_bkb_t") and r["x_bkb_t"] > 0 else None, 1),
                        num(r["x_dead_s"] / max(m["duration"] or 1, 1) * 100 if r.get("x_dead_s") is not None else None, 1),
                        num(r.get("x_dew")), num(r.get("x_obs_n")), num(r.get("x_obs_kill")), num(r.get("x_pwr")), num(r.get("x_wis")),

    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "players.csv"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:

"""Which games count, which teams are Tier 1, and how strong each team was at the time of each match.

1. Junk filter. OpenDota marks some non-events as "professional". A league is dropped when it
   runs longer than LEAGUE_MAX_DAYS (open ladders, club leagues), has fewer than 4 teams, has
   "streamer" in its name, or fewer than half of its games are between two registered teams
   (in-house and pickup leagues). Inside the leagues that stay, a single game is dropped when
   either side is not a registered team (mix stacks in open qualifiers).

2. Tier 1 teams. A team counts as Tier 1 for a match if it played at least TIER1_MIN_GAMES games
   at Tier 1 events (the main events of TI, DreamLeague, PGL Wallachia, ESL One, BLAST SLAM,
   FISSURE PLAYGROUND, Esports World Cup; never their qualifiers) within TIER1_WINDOW_DAYS before or after
   that match.

3. Team strength (Elo). Every team starts at 1500 and is updated after each counted game
   (K = ELO_K). Each game stores both teams' rating going into it. Tier 2 means a registered team that is
   not Tier 1 but was rated at least TIER2_MIN_ELO going into the game; everyone else is Tier 3.
"""
import collections, re

LEAGUE_MAX_DAYS = 150
TIER1_MIN_GAMES = 5
TIER1_WINDOW_DAYS = 180
ELO_K = 24
TIER2_MIN_ELO = 1500

TIER1_EVENT = re.compile(
    r"^(The International 20\d\d$|DreamLeague Season \d+$|PGL Wallachia 20\d\d Season|ESL One (?!.*Qualif)|"
    r"BLAST SLAM|FISSURE PLAYGROUND \d+$|"
    r"Esports World Cup 20\d\d$|Riyadh Masters)", re.I)


def is_tier1_event(name):
    name = (name or "").strip()
    return bool(TIER1_EVENT.search(name)) and "qualif" not in name.lower()


def filter_matches(M, leagues, teams):
    """Returns (kept match dict, list of dropped league ids with reasons)."""
    by = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for m in M.values():
        by[m["leagueid"]].append(m)
    known = lambda t: bool(t) and t in teams
    drop = {}
    for lid, ms in by.items():
        ts = [m["start_time"] for m in ms]
        n_teams = len({t for m in ms for t in (m.get("radiant_team_id"), m.get("dire_team_id")) if t})
        share = sum(1 for m in ms if known(m.get("radiant_team_id")) and known(m.get("dire_team_id"))) / len(ms)
        name = (leagues.get(lid, {}).get("name") or "")
        if (max(ts) - min(ts)) / 86400 > LEAGUE_MAX_DAYS:
            drop[lid] = "runs longer than %d days" % LEAGUE_MAX_DAYS
        elif n_teams < 4:
            drop[lid] = "fewer than 4 teams"
        elif "streamer" in name.lower():
            drop[lid] = "streamer show"
        elif share < 0.5:
            drop[lid] = "mostly unregistered teams"
    kept = {mid: m for mid, m in M.items()
            if m["leagueid"] not in drop and known(m.get("radiant_team_id")) and known(m.get("dire_team_id"))}
    return kept, drop


def team_tiers_and_elo(M, leagues):
    """Adds to every match: r_elo, d_elo (going into the game) and r_tier, d_tier (1, 2 or 3).
    Returns the latest Elo per team and a dict of Tier 1 status as of the newest game."""
    ms = sorted(M.values(), key=lambda m: (m["start_time"], m["match_id"]))
    t1_times = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for m in ms:
        if is_tier1_event(leagues.get(m["leagueid"], {}).get("name")):
            for t in (m["radiant_team_id"], m["dire_team_id"]):
                t1_times[t].append(m["start_time"])
    win = TIER1_WINDOW_DAYS * 86400

    def tier1(t, at):
        return sum(1 for x in t1_times.get(t, ()) if abs(x - at) <= win) >= TIER1_MIN_GAMES

    elo = collections.defaultdict(lambda: 1500.0)
    for m in ms:
        r, d = m["radiant_team_id"], m["dire_team_id"]
        er, ed = elo[r], elo[d]
        m["r_elo"], m["d_elo"] = round(er), round(ed)
        m["r_tier"] = 1 if tier1(r, m["start_time"]) else (2 if er >= TIER2_MIN_ELO else 3)
        m["d_tier"] = 1 if tier1(d, m["start_time"]) else (2 if ed >= TIER2_MIN_ELO else 3)
        p = 1 / (1 + 10 ** ((ed - er) / 400))
        s = 1.0 if m["radiant_win"] else 0.0
        elo[r] = er + ELO_K * (s - p)
        elo[d] = ed - ELO_K * (s - p)
    newest = ms[-1]["start_time"]
    return dict(elo), {t: tier1(t, newest) for t in elo}
